# Med USA

> > Med USA is a comprehensive healthcare revenue cycle management and credentialing partner delivering 40+ years of expertise in medical billing, provider credentialing, and analytics solutions.

Med USA specializes in end-to-end revenue cycle management services across multiple healthcare specialties including orthopedics, behavioral health, urgent care, and laboratory services. The company combines traditional RCM expertise with modern healthcare analytics platforms to help practices optimize revenue, reduce denials, and accelerate reimbursements.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing Services
- Provider Credentialing
- Healthcare Analytics
- Denial Management
- Healthcare Compliance
- Practice Management
- RCM Audit
- Payer Contracting
- ICD-10 Coding
- Specialty Billing (Orthopedics, Behavioral Health, Urgent Care, Laboratory)
- Domo Analytics Platform
- Multi-location Practice Support
